invokes Lightning Web Components Jest unit tests.

USAGE
  $ sf force lightning lwc test run [-d | --watch] [--json] [--loglevel trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL]

FLAGS
  -d, --debug                                                                           run tests in debug mode
      --json                                                                            format output as json
      --loglevel=(trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL)  [default: warn] logging level for this command invocation
      --watch                                                                           run tests in watch mode

DESCRIPTION
  invokes Lightning Web Components Jest unit tests.

EXAMPLES
  $ sfdx force:lightning:lwc:test:run

  $ sfdx force:lightning:lwc:test:run -w
